title: Software Test Generation Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Unit, integration, property-based, fuzz, and end-to-end test strategies with generators. The Software Test Generation Database creates the tests that software needs but developers never have time to write: unit tests per function, integration tests per interface, property-based tests that check invariants across thousands of random inputs, fuzz tests that hunt crashes, and end-to-end tests that walk real user flows. Each strategy record includes when to use it, what it catches, generator configurations, and how to read the failures it finds.

title: Software Test Generation Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Test pyramid: many unit tests, fewer integration tests, few end-to-end tests. Unit: arrange-act-assert; mock external dependencies. Property-based: for all inputs satisfying preconditions, the invariant holds; shrinking finds the minimal failing case. Example property for sort: sorted(out) and multiset(out)==multiset(in). Fuzzing: mutate valid inputs (bit flips, truncation, splicing); coverage-guided fuzzing keeps inputs that find new paths; crash triage deduplicates by stack hash. Integration: test the contract between modules, not their internals. E2E: full user flow with real dependencies (or faithful doubles). Metrics: line/branch coverage, mutation score (mutants killed / total mutants) — the honest quality metric.

demo.title: Verification: property-based test of sort
demo.code: function prop(a){const s=[...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y);const sorted=s.every((v,i)=>i===0||s[i-1]<=v);const perm=JSON.stringify([...a].sort((x,y)=>x-y))===JSON.stringify(s);return sorted&&perm;}let seed=42;function rnd(){seed=(seed*1103515245+12345)&0x7fffffff;return seed%100;}let pass=true;for(let t=0;t<200;t++){const a=Array.from({length:10},rnd);if(!prop(a)){pass=false;break;}}J({trials:200,pass});assert(pass,'property');

title: Software Test Generation Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: generator test (scaffolded tests compile and run); property test (seeded bugs are caught); fuzz test (known crashers found); coverage test (numbers match hand computation). Limitations: generated tests need oracle functions (expected behavior); shrinking needs deterministic code; E2E tests are environment-sensitive. Every generated suite records its strategy and seed.
